verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a programmable card-issuing and payments platform, but the evidence pack never documents a scheduler, recurring transfers, or cron-like workflows. Authorization rules, ASA and webhooks all react to events as they happen. Shadow-mode reports and backtesting measure impact over time but do not schedule anything, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
